source_audit_recovery.limitation: The original exact-count source audit failed on one weak NMS candidate at the MSK-003 tail. Failure retained and tolerance amendment recorded before any14Test accuracy. Matched numeric bounds and high/birth memberships were preserved. Fresh and canonical RGB are separate controls; low-confidence tracking equivalence is not assumed.

scope: Full7 historical Test sequences,15985 frames, official combined TrackEval. All14 cases were frozen from complete Dev. No Test-based checkpoint/readout selection. Historic Test was previously exposed; this remains exploratory research.
attribution: Positive seed0 Dev removals do not establish original innovations or Test gains. no_counterfactual removes both reliableRGB and wrong-aux losses; no_gate removes feature risk/bound and priority, although raw readout excludes priority.
timing: Cached ByteTrack replay FPS excludes detector/encoder/adapter preparation. Shared pixel production time is not per-method end-to-end FPS.
